tool.description: Returns the reader's own values: what matters to them, each a short name and an optional example of living it, as they wrote them for acceptance and commitment therapy. Give day (YYYY-MM-DD) for the values as they stood on that journal day, or nothing for the current ones. changedSince says whether the values changed after that day.
tool.label: Reading your values

payload.description: The day whose values are wanted; the current ones when left out.

reply.description: The version of the values in force on the day asked for: the latest one written on or before it.

day.description: The day that version was written; null when no values were written on or before the day asked for.

values.description: The values, in the client's order.

name.description: The value's short name, such as Being a present parent.

meaning.description: An example of living the value; empty for none.

changedSince.description: A later version exists: the values changed after the day asked for.

placed.description: Whether the journal day asked for shows Your values; left out when no day was asked for.
